summary: The mobile home screen switches between recent conversations and projects instead of stacking both, moves search and New conversation to header icons, uses monochrome tab icons, adds haptics and a clear unpin look to chat swipes, shows the connected desktop with a computer icon, shows a reply's model as quiet text instead of a box, opens Regent's reply actions with a long press on its bubbles, and lets the iPad sidebar be hidden with scheduled tasks as its own list.
